why: A button built without the primitive -- the shape of the defect #321 exists to remove, where `.hud-achievements-open` shipped with no base rule and rendered as a stock grey browser button beside three themed siblings. Two cases catch it and they catch DIFFERENT things: `never lets a button fall through to browser default styling` sees the rendering (the level buttons keep their own size rule, so they lose only fill, text colour and cursor), and `groups every button under a primitive` sees the omission itself, which is the property that still holds for a control whose own rule happens to cover everything. The second is what replaces `a new button joins by adding its selector to the group` now that the group is gone.
killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole groups every button under a primitive, or names it as a deliberate exception
